audit_metadata.auditor_role: Senior Machine Learning Engineer & Security ML Auditor
audit_metadata.project_name: SQL Shield AI - ML SQL Injection Detection Pipeline

split_id_overlap.evidence: Exact and normalized string sets across train, val, and test have 0 overlap.

tfidf_fitting_leakage.evidence: Saved vectorizer vocabulary and IDF weights exactly match a fresh fit on train.csv (0 differences). Difference with full clean dataset fit is 1,666 features.

duplicate_leakage.evidence: Near-duplicates (lowercased + collapsed whitespace) purged before splitting (103 near-duplicate queries dropped). 0 duplicate overlap across splits.

template_syntactic_overlap.evidence: 250 structural query templates (with normalized strings/numbers) are shared between train and test. While exact records do not overlap, high template similarity contributes to near-100% benchmark metrics.

label_target_leakage.evidence: Only SQL query text is transformed. No metadata, IDs, or target columns passed into feature extractor.

test_set_reuse.evidence: Model selection strictly executed on validation metrics (highest SQLi recall then F1). Test set evaluated post-selection.

critical_audit_findings: No classic data leakage was detected: train/val/test splits are mutually exclusive and TF-IDF was fitted strictly on train.csv.
Model selection rule in code strictly followed validation recall then F1, correctly choosing Random Forest without test set snooping.

Benign Prefix Camouflage Vulnerability: Raw TF-IDF Random Forest fails (score 0.42, False Negative) when an injection payload is embedded inside a long legitimate SQL query due to token dilution. Runtime app patches this with regex segment extraction.
Encoding & Obfuscation Vulnerabilities: Hex-encoded payloads (e.g. 0x61646d696e) bypass both raw models and regex segmenters (0% detection).
False Positive Risks on Non-English/Natural Language: Natural words containing SQL character n-grams (e.g. Catalan 'fogars de la selva' matching ' sel') trigger false alarms.
